held.flag: S1 (adopt-2002): its witness was refused at 2002 for the exception-object user word, which the rule names
held.answer: The S1 record shows the refused witness is pb922_exception_object_user_word_85, an 85 program using EXCEPTION-OBJECT as a user word, widened to 2002 and refused there (COBOL2196/COBOL1694). That refusal is right: 2002 makes EXCEPTION-OBJECT a predefined object reference (§2002:8.4.2.6) and a reserved word (§2002:8.9), so that program is not 2002 source. The rule's own witnesses hold at 2002: pb922_exception_object_reference passes (S1 class pass) and pb922-exception-object-receiving draws COBOL2196 (SR1's words) at --std 2002 (reader's refusals.log). Hold answered; no change.
